name: Between two Suns
source:
You’re a student, living in quite a big city, away from your parents, or perhaps you’ve never had them to begin with. Your life is pretty normal, sometimes you have bad days, sometimes good, most of them are… normal. 

One day, you managed to discover a perfect spot for a little break in the nearby forest - near a small stream, cozied inbetween birches with their leaves sounding above. You love going there whenever you're having a rough day. 

And then one day, you get intrigued by somebody's noisy argument...

Meet Sunset and Sunrise, an angel and a demon from another world. They escaped from their home in attempt to find a safer place.

Listen to their bickering, ask questions and question your perception of the world, and who knows, maybe at the end you’ll take one of them home. Or both, if you’re lucky.

[From [url=https://volsenn.itch.io/between-two-suns]itch.io[/url]]
